title: Data Scientist Agreement — Tier 3
full_text:
DATA SCIENTIST AGREEMENT — TIER 3

Date: 10th February 2025
Company: Enterprise Horizon 20 Pvt. Ltd.
Role: Data Scientist

1. Compensation and Benefits
The Company shall pay the Employee a total compensation of INR 14,00,000 per annum, payable in monthly instalments subject to statutory tax deductions.

2. Probationary Period
The Employee shall remain on probation for six (6) months from the date of joining. Performance will be reviewed prior to confirmation.

3. Notice Period and Separation
Following confirmation, either party may terminate employment by providing 60 days written notice or basic salary in lieu thereof.

4. Service Commitment and Training Bond
The Employee agrees to remain in service for at least 18 months following completion of training. In the event of breach, Employee shall pay INR 1,50,000 as liquidated damages.

5. Restrictive Covenant and Non-Compete
For 12 months following termination, the Employee agrees not to solicit clients or be employed by competing firms in India.

6. Confidentiality and Intellectual Property
All discoveries, software source codes, designs, and inventions created shall remain the exclusive proprietary property of the Company.

7. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
This contract shall be construed in accordance with the laws of India. Courts at Gurugram, Haryana have exclusive jurisdiction.

Sincerely,
Authorised Signatory
Enterprise Horizon 20 Pvt. Ltd.
